title: Mohsen Hachtroudi and the Geometry of Differential Equations
summary: Mohsen Hachtroudi (1908--1976) was one of the founders of modern mathematics in Iran and the first Iranian mathematician to gain international recognition for original research in modern times. A student of Élie Cartan, he introduced the canonical projective connection now known as the \emph{Hachtroudi connection}, whose significance has become increasingly apparent through later developments in Cartan geometry, CR geometry, and parabolic geometry.
